competences.description: Attacks the enemy to remove 1 beneficial effect with a 50% chance. This attack will deal more damage according to your Defense.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)

competences.description: Recovers your HP and the HP of the ally with the lowest HP ratio, and then attacks all enemies to deal damage proportionate to your Defense and provoke them for 1 turn with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target is forced to attack the Monster that is provoked.

competences.description: Increases the Attack Power of all allies for 2 turns and defends all allies excluding yourself for 2 turns. Receives half of the damage inflicted on the defended target while making the damage 0 for the defended target and counterattacks the enemy target.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be increased by 50%.
The caster of this skill will receive half of the damage inflicted on the escorted target while making the damage dealt to the defended target to 0 and counterattack the enemy target.
